_note: Corrections applied on top of the quiz each time the page loads. Match a question by its chapter and its exact current question text (the 'q' field). REMOVE deletes it; EDIT overwrites only the fields you list in 'set'. Edit this file on GitHub and commit — changes go live on the next visit. Examples: remove -> {"chapter":8,"q":"full question text here"} ; fix an answer -> {"chapter":8,"q":"full question text here","set":{"correct":2}} ; fix wording -> {"chapter":8,"q":"old question text","set":{"q":"new question text"}}. correct is a 0-based index into options.
